manifest.size_constraint: Capped at <=45,000 nodes / 150,000 relationships to fit the most conservative published Neo4j AuraDB Free limit (50k nodes / 175k relationships). Neo4j's FAQ states 200k/400k; the product announcement states 50k/175k. We sized to the smaller figure.

Observed in CognoDB console for instance db-230f88c8 (c0, us-east4, v0.9.11). NOTE: the assignment brief states 256 MB; the provisioned instance reports 512 MB. We benchmark against the observed spec. Also enforced: max 200 connections, up to 500 disk IOPS, and a hard server-side cap of 50,000 result rows per query.
